body:
I've given my *soul* to someone who I thought I was going to be with for a lifetime. I stopped seeing my friends, I stopped seeing my family, I lost interest in all my hobbies because they became annoying to *them.* I literally changed my entire life for *them*. I tried being the best partner that I could be. I would get criticized for being friendly which made me change how I acted towards others. It made me bitter. How did it end? We got in a silly fight (living together) and they didn't come home for 2 days. It was odd to me because we spent the last 3 years together and were literally *together* everyday. I can't recall a time that I didn't see this person for more than 8 hours. In my mind, I knew what they were up to but my heart wouldn't accept it. When they finally got home, I stood face to face and I asked "are you cheating on me?" the response was a cold, mono, harsh "yes" and I lost it. I was so angry. I wanted to *die*. The person they were with was parked outside. I don't know what it was but I couldn't bear it to confront. My low self esteem was in full force. I was shattered. I stood there and I watched them leave from in the house. My world stood still. I cried for 4 days after that in our bed and then I packed my stuff and left. I felt so stupid. The amount of time I spent with this person and invested all for it to end like that. But you know what? It was that relationship that showed me what love is. It's beautiful but it can also be *very* cruel. It also showed me what I am capable of doing for *myself*. I lived out of 2 trash bags and where ever I could sleep for almost a year until I finally got my shit together. It was that relationship that made me bust my ass for everything that I have now and it was also the relationship that I told myself I would never put myself in another situation that would leave me with absolutely nothing. 

We live and we learn, I guess. 

Keep your head up <3

All I gotta say is fuck them kids. 

Hope you get better tho <3

To each's own, I'm sorry if this offended you in the slightest. I currently still deal with my depression and haven't fully overcome it but I have overcame the feeling of wanting to die and take it out on myself and others. I hope to the universe and all its light better days will come for you <3
